summary: Verified complete OLD CRM port to Connect Files module. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass covering (1) 24 statuses across 9 categories, (2) Dashboard stats with 519 total files & all OLD CRM counters (new=2, in_progress=29, login=323, approved=116, disbursed=96, interim_rejects=100, final_rejections=284, pipeline=₹1.99Cr), (3) Rejected report with bank_summary (IDFC, HDFC, ICICI, AXIS, PIRAMAL, INDUSIND, INCRED, HERO, KOTAK) & totals {not_eligible:54, not_login:36, declined:93, not_disbursed:4}, (4) Growth Partner report with current/spillover keys (files_generated_current/spillover, logins_current/spillover, approvals_current/spillover, disbursals_current/spillover, disbursed_amount_current/spillover), (5) Star Rating endpoint returns valid star_rating (0-5) & star_score (0-100), sample=4/75, (6) File detail returns all sections (Customer, Employment, Obligations, Loan Requirements) with file_details keys (mother_name, current_address, company_name, net_salary, cibil_score, loan_amount_required, type_of_loan etc), (7) Update /details endpoint persists additional_data fields. Frontend: Files Dashboard renders exactly 519 Total Files with all 10 metric cards (Total, New, In Progress, Login, Approved, Total Approved ₹13.58Cr, Disbursed, Total Disbursed ₹11.70Cr, Interim Rejects, Final Rejections, Amt in Pipeline ₹1.99Cr) plus Loans by Type breakdown and File Status Distribution donut. Report action buttons (Daily Report, Rejected, Growth Partner, Bank Perf., TAT, Quality, Policy) all visible in header. File Detail page displays all 4 numbered sections with Edit Details button, star rating in header (0/100), Check Bank Eligibility action, Documents upload area, Activity Log, and Add Note form.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY (persistent from iter27/28): Multiple /api/files/* endpoints still lack auth guard — /api/files/statuses (public by intent maybe OK), but PUT /api/files/{file_id}/details, PUT /api/files/{file_id}/file-status, POST /api/files/{file_id}/notes, PUT /api/files/{file_id}/assign, PUT /api/files/bulk-assign, PUT /api/files/{file_id}/eligibilities, GET /api/files/{file_id}/eligibilities, GET /api/files/{file_id}/activities, POST /api/files/{file_id}/upload, GET /api/files/{file_id}/documents, GET /api/files/download/{doc_id}, DELETE /api/files/{file_id}/documents/{doc_id} — no Depends(get_current_user) — anyone can modify file data or download PII documents. HIGH priority.
files_crm.py is 2506 lines — should be split into files_crud.py, files_reports.py, files_policies.py, files_documents.py, files_ratings.py.
Dashboard stats & GP report load all files into memory (.to_list(10000)) then filter in Python — will not scale past ~10k files. Move status/date filters into MongoDB aggregation pipeline.
update_file_details endpoint has NO validation of who can edit — any authenticated user (or unauthenticated!) can edit any file including changing assigned_to via other endpoints.
seed_data_creation: None — used TEST_Iter29 update on existing file id 0d8133f3-2f35-40ae-8d08-71c0766b3170 (loan_amount_required set to 500000, type_of_loan='Personal Loan'). Non-destructive but did modify one legacy record — main agent may want to revert if it corrupts a real customer record.
